headline: Continued 60-unit housing plan at 196 and 198 Rockingham Road to October 14; approved waivers for 12 Jack's Bridge Road warehouse.
summary: Granted 120-day extensions for 36 and 44 Pillsbury Road and a one-year extension for Mack's Apples at 230 Mammoth Road. Approved a waiver letting work start on 230 Mammoth Road before plans are signed. Recommended Brian Battaglia for the Southern New Hampshire Planning Commission.
decisions: Continued the 60-unit site plan at 196 and 198 Rockingham Road to October 14, 2026, 8-0.
Granted 120-day extensions for 36 Pillsbury Road and 44 Pillsbury Road to December 4, 2026, 8-0.
Granted a one-year extension for Mack's Apples at 230 Mammoth Road to August 6, 2027, 8-0.
Approved a waiver letting work on the interior and exterior of 230 Mammoth Road start before plans are signed, 8-0.
Accepted the 12 Jack's Bridge Road warehouse application as complete, 8-0.
Approved waivers 1-4 for the 12 Jack's Bridge Road warehouse, 8-0.
Continued the hearing on the 105,000-square foot warehouse site plan at 12 Jack's Bridge Road to September 2, 2026, 8-0.
Recommended to the Town Council that Brian Battaglia be appointed to the Southern New Hampshire Planning Commission for a four-year term, 7-0-1.

decision_evidence.quote: T. DeFrancesco made a motion to approve the minutes of the July 8, 2026, Board meeting as presented. G. Verani seconded the motion. The motion carried 6-0-1, with T. DeFrancesco abstaining.
T. DeFrancesco made a motion to continue this case until October 14, 2026. J. Farrell seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Farrell made a motion to grant the 120-day extension requests for 36 Pillsbury Road and 44 Pillsbury Road to December 4, 2026. G. Verani seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
T. DeFrancesco made a motion to grant the one-year extension request for Mack's Apples, 230 Mammoth Road, Map 6, Lot 21 to August 6, 2027. J. Cruz seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.

J. Farrell made a motion that the Planning Board votes to approve the request of 230 Mammoth Road, Tax Map 6, Lot 21, for the allowance to make improvements limited to the interior and exterior of the building. J. Cruz seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Cruz made a motion to waive Section 3.05 for acceptance purposes only and to accept the application as complete. J. Verani seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Farrell made a motion to approve waivers 1-4 in the memo dated August 5, 2026. T. DeFrancesco seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.
J. Farrell made a motion to continue this hearing to September 2, 2026. T. DeFrancesco seconded the motion. The motion carried 8-0-0.

J. Farrell moved that the Board make a recommendation to the Town Council to appoint Brian Battaglia to the Southern New Hampshire Planning Commission for a four-year term. T. DeFrancesco seconded the motion. The motion carried 7-0-1, with S. Faber abstaining.
